lines.cap: Lost in the woods? Stay put, get loud, and make yourself big.
lines.say: Lost in the woods? Stay put, get loud, and make yourself big.

lines.cap: Most people who get lost make it worse by walking. They panic, and wander further from where searchers will look.
lines.say: Most people who get lost make it worse by walking. They panic, and wander further from where searchers will look.

lines.cap: Rule one. Stop. Sit down, calm down, and stay where you are. Hug a tree if it helps.
lines.say: Rule one. Stop. Sit down, calm down, and stay where you are. Hug a tree if it helps.

lines.cap: Rule two. Get loud. Three blasts on a whistle is the signal for help. It carries further than your voice, and it won't wear you out.
lines.say: Rule two. Get loud. Three blasts on a whistle is the signal for help. It carries further than your voice, and it won't wear you out.

lines.cap: Rule three. Make yourself big. Bright clothes, an open spot, anything shiny or colourful, so searchers can see you from above.
lines.say: Rule three. Make yourself big. Bright clothes, an open spot, anything shiny or colourful, so searchers can see you from above.

lines.cap: Then stay warm and dry. Get off the cold ground, and out of the wind.
lines.say: Then stay warm and dry. Get off the cold ground, and out of the wind.

lines.cap: Searchers start where you were last seen. If you stay put, they find you faster.
lines.say: Searchers start where you were last seen. If you stay put, they find you faster.

lines.cap: Stop. Get loud. Get big. Save this before your next hike.
lines.say: Stop. Get loud. Get big. Save this before your next hike.
